display_name: Manufacturing — Light Metal Fabrication, Grill & Gate Workshop
overview: Iron gates, window grills, steel railings, tin sheds, and structural metal fabrication. Order-driven job work relying on customer advances (40-50% upfront before raw material cutting, balance upon installation). Sourcing raw material steel pipes and angle irons with high price volatility.
red_flags_json: Unfinished delayed customer orders with advance money already consumed
Commercial electricity disconnection or power theft disputes
Heavy financial dependency on a single building contractor who defaults
Inadequate welding ventilation and lack of basic workshop safety gear
